open_points.question: When the requested name fails condition 1 of A3 rule 5, must read_named_source open no file as INV-02 requires, or must it still read one file once as its observable effect states?
options: Open no file when condition 1 fails; read one file once only after the name and path pass condition 1.
Always read one file once, including when condition 1 fails.
open_points.default_guess: Open no file when condition 1 fails; make the observable effect conditional on the name and path passing condition 1.

witness.initial: Content has no placement, and the delivery request names an empty, absolute, ignored, dotted, linked, or otherwise invalid path.
events: The authenticated calling flow requests delivery of that name.
A file-open trace records whether any named file, later path segment, or link target is opened.
outcomes: INV-02 requires that no such file or target is opened and the delivery returns NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT.
The observable effect says read_named_source reads one file once.
witness.observer: The calling flow and the file-open tracer.
